blaze.name: Blaze

engine.name: The Engine
engine.tagline: An immortal wanderer reseeded life after life across fifty galaxies and a hundred thousand years.

sky-pillar.name: Sky Pillar
sky-pillar.tagline: The rise of a sentient cultivator tree to world-shaking power.

charlatan.name: The Charlatan
charlatan.tagline: The con artist who fooled the Heavens — the mortal origin of the Primordial God Skolar.

nine-vaults.name: The Nine Vaults Continent

cotl.name: Champion of the Light
